description: Resolve labels to the numeric codes or exact alphanumeric item identities faostat_query_observations needs: areas (countries/regions), items (commodities), and elements (metrics). Use query for full-text matching, name_contains for substring matching, code or code_text for exact identity, m49_code to find areas by M49 code, or omit them to list. Item and element matches occur in the selected domain; areas use shared vocabulary. For elements, optionally pass item_codes or item_codes_text to discover metrics and distinct units observed for those items; this does not establish area/year/source coverage. Empty item selectors match nothing. Page with offset and limit using nextOffset when truncated. Areas carry country/aggregate classification and the M49 code FAO publishes for each, a standard key for joining other sources. Verified domain-specific item groups carry aggregate; null means unclassified, not safe-to-sum. Item groups can overlap their members even with matching units. Area aggregates include codes ≥ 5000 and curated roll-ups such as China=351; exclude overlapping regional and country rows when summing.

code.description: Exact code lookup. Takes precedence over `query`/`name_contains` when provided.

code_text.description: Exact alphanumeric item code; letters are uppercased before lookup, so 210400f reads as 210400F. Only for dimension item; mutually exclusive with code. Numeric identities use code.

domain.description: FAOSTAT domain code (e.g. "QCL"). Item and element resolution is scoped to the codes present in this domain's data; area code lists are shared across all indexed domains.

item_codes.description: For element resolution only: restrict elements and units to these items. Empty matches nothing; omit for domain-wide elements. Mutually exclusive with item_codes_text.

item_codes_text.description: For element resolution only: restrict elements and units to these exact text items, letters uppercased before lookup. Empty matches nothing; mutually exclusive with item_codes.

limit.description: Matches to return on this page, at most 200 per call.

m49_code.description: Exact M49 area code: one to three digits, optionally a dot and more digits, such as "840" or "002.03". The integer part is zero-padded to three digits before lookup, so "40" reads as "040". Returns every area carrying the code on one page. Only for dimension area; mutually exclusive with code and code_text; takes precedence over query and name_contains.

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter over the label. Used only when `query` is omitted.

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset into the match set. When the response reports truncated, pass the returned nextOffset here to fetch the next page. Ignored for exact lookups by code, code_text, or m49_code (always single-page).

query.description: Full-text search term, FTS5-matched against the dimension labels with prefix matching (e.g. "wheat", "import quantity"). Relevance-ranked. Quotes, parentheses, asterisks, and control characters separate words. Blank or "*" reads as omitted; any other value made only of quotes, parentheses, asterisks, and whitespace, such as "()", fails invalid_query. Unread when code, code_text, or m49_code is given.

name: faostat_resolve_codes

effectiveLimit.description: The limit the call was served at. Present only when limit was capped.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_item_scope`: Item selectors are combined or supplied outside element resolution. `invalid_text_selector`: code_text is supplied with code or outside the item dimension. `invalid_m49_selector`: m49_code is supplied outside the area dimension, or with code or code_text. `invalid_query`: No code, code_text, or m49_code was given, and query is made only of quotes, parentheses, asterisks, and whitespace, such as "()" or "**", so no search term is left. A lone "*" lists instead. `unknown_domain`: The domain code is not a selected (indexed) FAOSTAT domain. `index_not_ready`: The shared dimension tables are empty, or the selected item/element domain requires an initial sync or an ingest upgrade. `query_timeout`: The item or element lookup's mirror read — time queued behind other calls' reads plus execution — ran past the 45-second per-call ceiling. `pool_closed`: The server was shutting down and closed its mirror read workers while this call was queued or running. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

matches.description: Matching codes, relevance-ranked for query mode, else by code.

code.description: Numeric code for faostat_query_observations; null for alphanumeric items carried by code_text.

code_text.description: Exact alphanumeric item identity for item_codes_text; null for numeric codes.

cpc_code.description: CPC crosswalk code for items (apostrophe stripped), when available.

kind.description: For areas: country or aggregate region. For items: aggregate only for verified domain-specific groups; null means unclassified, never safe-to-sum. Null for elements.

m49_code.description: Areas only: FAO's published M49 code, a string with its leading zeros (840, 001). The excluding-intra-trade aggregates carry dotted FAO extensions such as 002.03, and historical entities their former codes. Absent for items and elements, and for an area whose code list carries none.

units.description: Element matches only: distinct non-null units observed in the selected domain and item scope. Empty means no specified units.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass on the next call to fetch the following page. Present only when truncated is true; absent on the last page and for exact-code lookups.

notice.description: Guidance when limit was above its cap, nothing matched, more pages remain, or the dimension is not yet indexed.

requestedLimit.description: The limit the call asked for. Present only when it was above the 200 cap.

totalMatches.description: Total matches in this domain before the result cap.

truncated.description: True when more matches remain beyond the returned page — fetch them with nextOffset.
